title: Discipline models consume the approved spatial framework
test_intent: Determine whether each governed discipline model references the Standalone Coordination File and uses its approved spatial framework as the model-setup authority.

applicability.applies_when: A governed discipline model participates in a project using the Standalone Coordination File as the approved spatial authority.
applicability.not_applicable_when: The subject is not a governed discipline model participating in the project's shared spatial framework.

required_evidence: reference relationship to the governed Standalone Coordination File
approved spatial-framework baseline from the Standalone Coordination File
observed discipline-model spatial-framework values or alignment signature

result_logic.pass: The discipline model references the governed Standalone Coordination File and its observed spatial framework matches the approved authoritative baseline for the tested project state.
result_logic.fail: The discipline model does not reference the governed Standalone Coordination File, uses an alternate peer authority path, or its observed spatial framework does not match the approved authoritative baseline.
result_logic.not_applicable: The subject is outside the governed discipline-model shared-coordinate scope.
result_logic.indeterminate: The authoritative baseline, reference relationship, or model spatial-framework evidence is unavailable or insufficient to establish alignment.

provenance.migration_note: First conformance pilot ATS. The test remains tool-neutral; a future Revit ETS may inspect link/reference and shared-coordinate state.
